twitchchat.config.title: Twitch Chat Widget
twitchchat.config.connect.tip: Join the channel now. Pressing Enter in the box does the same.
twitchchat.config.enabled.tip: Turn the widget off to hide it and disconnect from Twitch. A key for this can be bound under Controls.
twitchchat.config.reset.tip: Move the widget back to its default place and size.
twitchchat.config.resetAll.tip: Restore every setting except the channel.
twitchchat.config.drag: Drag the outlined box to move the chat, drag its corner to resize it. Press %s in game to come back here.
twitchchat.config.style.tip: Panel: one box with an optional header. Lines: a strip behind each message, like vanilla chat. Minimal: only the messages, nothing else.
twitchchat.config.theme.tip: Colours of the background and text. Not used by the Minimal style, which has no background.
twitchchat.config.opacity.tip: How solid the background is. 0% leaves only the text.
twitchchat.config.header.tip: Bar with the channel name and connection dot. Panel style only.
twitchchat.config.shadow.tip: Text shadow, which keeps text readable on a see-through background. Not used by the Light theme.
twitchchat.config.nameColors.tip: Show each chatter's name in their Twitch colour, adjusted to stay readable on the theme.
twitchchat.config.lifetime.tip: How long a message stays on screen. Drag fully left to keep messages forever.
twitchchat.config.hideWhenEmpty.tip: Hide the whole widget while no message is showing, so an empty box never covers the game.
twitchchat.config.showAllInChat.tip: Bring faded messages back while the Minecraft chat is open.
twitchchat.config.notices.tip: Show subs, raids and other announcements from Twitch.
twitchchat.config.hideCommands.tip: Skip messages that start with "!", which are usually bot commands.
